```{r}

# Inspect columns
str(crime_raw)
head(crime_raw)

```

```{r}
# Data Cleaning
crime <- crime_raw %>%
  filter(!is.na(Latitude), !is.na(Longitude), !is.na(Date)) %>%
  mutate(
    Date = parse_date_time(Date, orders = c("mdy HMS", "mdy HM", "ymd HMS", "ymd HM"))
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(Date)) %>%
  mutate(
    year = year(Date),
    month = month(Date),
    month_name = month(Date, label = TRUE, abbr = TRUE),
    day = day(Date),
    wday = wday(Date, label = TRUE, abbr = FALSE),
    hour = hour(Date),
    year_month = floor_date(Date, unit = "month")
  ) %>%
  filter(year >= 2022, year <= 2024)
```

```{r}
# Convert to sf object
crime_sf <- st_as_sf(
  crime,
  coords = c("Longitude", "Latitude"),
  crs = 4326,
  remove = FALSE
)

# Reproject to a projected CRS suitable for Chicago
# UTM zone 16N
crime_sf_proj <- st_transform(crime_sf, 26916)
```

```{r}
# ASPATIAL ESTDA

total_crimes

mean_monthly <- mean(monthly_counts$crime_count)
sd_monthly <- sd(monthly_counts$crime_count)
```

```{r}
# Spatial join crime points to grid (crime area only)
# Remove coordinate outliers first
crime_clean <- crime %>%
  filter(
  !is.na(Latitude),
  !is.na(Longitude),
  !is.na(Date),
  Longitude > -88,
  Longitude < -87.5,
  Latitude > 41.6,
  Latitude < 42.05
)

# Rebuild sf object from cleaned data
crime_sf <- st_as_sf(
  crime_clean,
  coords = c("Longitude", "Latitude"),
  crs = 4326,
  remove = FALSE
)

crime_sf_proj <- st_transform(crime_sf, 26916)

# Count crimes per grid cell
grid_2km <- st_make_grid(
  crime_sf_proj,
  cellsize = 2000,
  square = TRUE
) %>%
  st_as_sf() %>%
  mutate(grid_id = row_number())

# Join counts back to grid
crime_grid_join <- st_join(crime_sf_proj, grid_2km, join = st_within)

grid_counts <- crime_grid_join %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  count(grid_id, name = "crime_count")

grid_sf <- grid_2km %>%
  left_join(grid_counts, by = "grid_id") %>%
  mutate(crime_count = replace_na(crime_count, 0))
```

```{r}
# Choropleth map of counts
tm_shape(grid_sf %>% filter(crime_count > 0)) +
  tm_polygons(
    col = "crime_count",
    style = "quantile",
    palette = "Reds",
    title = "Crime count"
  ) +
  tm_borders(col = "white", lwd = 0.2) +
  tm_layout(frame = FALSE)
```

```{r}
# grid-based hotspot map
grid_1km <- st_make_grid(crime_sf_proj, cellsize = 1000, square = TRUE) %>%
  st_as_sf() %>%
  mutate(cell_id = row_number())

crime_grid_join_fine <- st_join(crime_sf_proj, grid_1km, join = st_within)

fine_counts <- crime_grid_join_fine %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  count(cell_id, name = "crime_count")

fine_grid_sf <- grid_1km %>%
  left_join(fine_counts, by = "cell_id") %>%
  mutate(crime_count = ifelse(is.na(crime_count), 0, crime_count))

tm_shape(fine_grid_sf) +
  tm_polygons(
    col = "crime_count",
    style = "fixed",
    breaks = c(0, 100, 500, 1000, 3000, 12000),
    palette = "Reds",
    title = "Crime count"
  ) +
  tm_layout(frame = FALSE)
```

```{r}
# Spatial Autocorrelation

# Neighbours and weights 
nb <- poly2nb(grid_sf)
lw <- nb2listw(nb, style = "W", zero.policy = TRUE)

# Neighbourhood structure
summary(card(nb))
table(card(nb))

# Global Moran's I
moran_result <- moran.test(grid_sf$crime_count, lw, zero.policy = TRUE)
moran_result

# Local Moran's I
local_moran <- localmoran(grid_sf$crime_count, lw, zero.policy = TRUE)

grid_sf$Ii <- local_moran[, 1]
grid_sf$Z_Ii <- local_moran[, 4]
grid_sf$P_Ii <- local_moran[, 5]
```

```{r}
# LISA cluster map
lag_crime <- lag.listw(lw, grid_sf$crime_count, zero.policy = TRUE)

crime_mean <- mean(grid_sf$crime_count, na.rm = TRUE)
lag_mean <- mean(lag_crime, na.rm = TRUE)

grid_sf <- grid_sf %>%
  mutate(
    crime_std = crime_count - crime_mean,
    lag_std = lag_crime - lag_mean,
    lisa_cluster = case_when(
      crime_std > 0 & lag_std > 0 & P_Ii <= 0.05 ~ "High-High",
      crime_std < 0 & lag_std < 0 & P_Ii <= 0.05 ~ "Low-Low",
      crime_std > 0 & lag_std < 0 & P_Ii <= 0.05 ~ "High-Low",
      crime_std < 0 & lag_std > 0 & P_Ii <= 0.05 ~ "Low-High",
      TRUE ~ "Not significant"
    )
  )

tm_shape(grid_sf) +
  tm_polygons(
    col = "lisa_cluster",
    palette = c(
      "High-High" = "red",
      "Low-Low" = "blue",
      "High-Low" = "orange",
      "Low-High" = "lightblue",
      "Not significant" = "grey85"
    ),
    title = "LISA cluster"
  ) +
  tm_borders(col = "white", lwd = 0.2) +
  tm_layout(frame = FALSE)
```

```{r}
# Spatial-temporal map 2022, 2023, 2024
years <- c(2022, 2023, 2024)

for (y in years) {

  crime_year <- crime_sf_proj %>%
    filter(year == y)

  crime_grid_year <- st_join(crime_year, grid_2km, join = st_within)

  grid_counts_year <- crime_grid_year %>%
    st_drop_geometry() %>%
    count(grid_id, name = "crime_count")

  grid_year <- grid_2km %>%
    left_join(grid_counts_year, by = "grid_id") %>%
    mutate(crime_count = replace_na(crime_count, 0))

  print(
    tm_shape(grid_year) +
      tm_polygons(
        col = "crime_count",
        style = "fixed",
        breaks = c(0, 100, 500, 1000, 3000, max(grid_year$crime_count)),
        palette = "Reds"
      ) +
      tm_layout(
        title = paste("Crime hotspots in Chicago,", y),
        frame = FALSE
      )
  )
}

```

```{r}
# Temporal autocorrelation
monthly_counts <- crime %>%
  count(year_month, name = "crime_count") %>%
  complete(
    year_month = seq(min(year_month), max(year_month), by = "month"),
    fill = list(crime_count = 0)
  ) %>%
  arrange(year_month)

crime_ts <- ts(monthly_counts$crime_count, frequency = 12)

# Plot series
autoplot(crime_ts) +
  labs(
    title = "Monthly crime counts in Chicago",
    x = "Time",
    y = "Crime count"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

# Seasonal Decomposition
crime_decomp <- stl(crime_ts, s.window = "periodic")
autoplot(crime_decomp) +
  labs(title = "STL decomposition of monthly crime counts") +
  theme_minimal()

# STL decomposition was used to examine whether the monthly crime series contained trend and seasonal components. Given the short time span of three years, the decomposition was interpreted cautiously.

# ACF and PACF
acf(crime_ts, main = "ACF of monthly crime counts")
pacf(crime_ts, main = "PACF of monthly crime counts")

adf_result <- adf.test(crime_ts)
adf_result

if (adf_result$p.value >= 0.05) {
  crime_ts_diff <- diff(crime_ts)
  
  autoplot(crime_ts_diff) +
    labs(
      title = "Differenced monthly crime counts",
      x = "Time",
      y = "Differenced crime count"
    ) +
    theme_minimal()
  
  acf(crime_ts_diff, main = "ACF of differenced series")
  pacf(crime_ts_diff, main = "PACF of differenced series")
  
  adf_diff_result <- adf.test(crime_ts_diff)
  adf_diff_result
}
```
```{r}
# Weekly crime series
weekly_counts <- crime %>%
  mutate(year_week = floor_date(Date, unit = "week", week_start = 1)) %>%
  count(year_week, name = "crime_count") %>%
  complete(
    year_week = seq(min(year_week), max(year_week), by = "week"),
    fill = list(crime_count = 0)
  ) %>%
  arrange(year_week)

weekly_counts <- weekly_counts %>%
  filter(year_week < max(year_week))

ggplot(weekly_counts, aes(x = year_week, y = crime_count)) +
  geom_line() +
  labs(
    title = "Weekly crime counts in Chicago",
    x = "Week",
    y = "Crime count"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

crime_ts_weekly <- ts(weekly_counts$crime_count, frequency = 52)

# Shared train/test split for all weekly time-series models
n_ts_weekly <- length(crime_ts_weekly)
train_size_weekly <- floor(0.8 * n_ts_weekly)

train_ts_weekly <- ts(
  weekly_counts$crime_count[1:train_size_weekly],
  frequency = 52
)

test_ts_weekly <- ts(
  weekly_counts$crime_count[(train_size_weekly + 1):n_ts_weekly],
  frequency = 52
)

test_dates_weekly <- weekly_counts$year_week[(train_size_weekly + 1):n_ts_weekly]

# STL decomposition
crime_decomp_weekly <- stl(crime_ts_weekly, s.window = "periodic")
autoplot(crime_decomp_weekly) +
  labs(title = "STL decomposition of weekly crime counts") +
  theme_minimal()

# ACF and PACF
acf(crime_ts_weekly, main = "ACF of weekly crime counts")
pacf(crime_ts_weekly, main = "PACF of weekly crime counts")

# ADF test
adf_result_weekly <- adf.test(crime_ts_weekly)
adf_result_weekly

if (adf_result_weekly$p.value >= 0.05) {
  crime_ts_weekly_diff <- diff(crime_ts_weekly)

  autoplot(crime_ts_weekly_diff) +
    labs(
      title = "Differenced weekly crime counts",
      x = "Time",
      y = "Differenced crime count"
    ) +
    theme_minimal()

  acf(crime_ts_weekly_diff, main = "ACF of differenced weekly series")
  pacf(crime_ts_weekly_diff, main = "PACF of differenced weekly series")

  adf_diff_result_weekly <- adf.test(crime_ts_weekly_diff)
  adf_diff_result_weekly
}
```

```{r}
# Naive baseline model
naive_fc_weekly <- naive(train_ts_weekly, h = length(test_ts_weekly))

naive_rmse <- rmse(as.numeric(test_ts_weekly), as.numeric(naive_fc_weekly$mean))
naive_mae  <- mae(as.numeric(test_ts_weekly), as.numeric(naive_fc_weekly$mean))

naive_plot_data <- tibble(
  year_week = test_dates_weekly,
  actual = as.numeric(test_ts_weekly),
  predicted = as.numeric(naive_fc_weekly$mean)
)

ggplot(naive_plot_data, aes(x = year_week)) +
  geom_line(aes(y = actual, linetype = "Actual")) +
  geom_line(aes(y = predicted, linetype = "Predicted")) +
  labs(
    title = "Naive baseline versus actual weekly crime counts",
    x = "Week",
    y = "Crime count",
    linetype = ""
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
# Non-seasonal ARIMA
arima_model_ns <- auto.arima(train_ts_weekly, seasonal = FALSE)
summary(arima_model_ns)
checkresiduals(arima_model_ns)

arima_fc_ns <- forecast(arima_model_ns, h = length(test_ts_weekly))

arima_ns_rmse <- rmse(as.numeric(test_ts_weekly), as.numeric(arima_fc_ns$mean))
arima_ns_mae  <- mae(as.numeric(test_ts_weekly), as.numeric(arima_fc_ns$mean))

arima_ns_plot_data <- tibble(
  year_week = test_dates_weekly,
  actual = as.numeric(test_ts_weekly),
  predicted = as.numeric(arima_fc_ns$mean)
)

ggplot(arima_ns_plot_data, aes(x = year_week)) +
  geom_line(aes(y = actual, linetype = "Actual")) +
  geom_line(aes(y = predicted, linetype = "Predicted")) +
  labs(
    title = "Non-seasonal ARIMA versus actual weekly crime counts",
    x = "Week",
    y = "Crime count",
    linetype = ""
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

# Seasonal SARIMA
sarima_model <- auto.arima(train_ts_weekly, seasonal = TRUE)
summary(sarima_model)
checkresiduals(sarima_model)

sarima_fc <- forecast(sarima_model, h = length(test_ts_weekly))

sarima_rmse <- rmse(as.numeric(test_ts_weekly), as.numeric(sarima_fc$mean))
sarima_mae  <- mae(as.numeric(test_ts_weekly), as.numeric(sarima_fc$mean))

sarima_plot_data <- tibble(
  year_week = test_dates_weekly,
  actual = as.numeric(test_ts_weekly),
  predicted = as.numeric(sarima_fc$mean)
)

ggplot(sarima_plot_data, aes(x = year_week)) +
  geom_line(aes(y = actual, linetype = "Actual")) +
  geom_line(aes(y = predicted, linetype = "Predicted")) +
  labs(
    title = "Seasonal SARIMA versus actual weekly crime counts",
    x = "Week",
    y = "Crime count",
    linetype = ""
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```

```{r}
# Random Forest model weekly
rf_data <- weekly_counts %>%
  mutate(
    week_num = isoweek(year_week),
    year_num = year(year_week),
    month_num = month(year_week),

    lag1 = lag(crime_count, 1),
    lag2 = lag(crime_count, 2),
    lag3 = lag(crime_count, 3),
    lag4 = lag(crime_count, 4),
    lag12 = lag(crime_count, 12),
    lag52 = lag(crime_count, 52),

    roll_mean_4 = lag(rollmean(crime_count, k = 4, fill = NA, align = "right"), 1),
    roll_mean_12 = lag(rollmean(crime_count, k = 12, fill = NA, align = "right"), 1),

    sin_week = sin(2 * pi * week_num / 52),
    cos_week = cos(2 * pi * week_num / 52)
  ) %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(lag52),
    !is.na(roll_mean_4),
    !is.na(roll_mean_12)
  )

ggplot(rf_data, aes(x = year_week, y = crime_count)) +
  geom_line() +
  labs(
    title = "Weekly crime counts used for Random Forest",
    x = "Week",
    y = "Crime count"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

# Train/test split for RF
train_size_rf <- floor(0.8 * nrow(rf_data))

rf_train <- rf_data[1:train_size_rf, ]
rf_test  <- rf_data[(train_size_rf + 1):nrow(rf_data), ]

XTrain <- rf_train %>%
  select(
    week_num, year_num, month_num,
    lag1, lag2, lag3, lag4, lag12, lag52,
    roll_mean_4, roll_mean_12,
    sin_week, cos_week
  )

yTrain <- rf_train$crime_count

XTest <- rf_test %>%
  select(
    week_num, year_num, month_num,
    lag1, lag2, lag3, lag4, lag12, lag52,
    roll_mean_4, roll_mean_12,
    sin_week, cos_week
  )

yTest <- rf_test$crime_count

set.seed(101)

rf_model <- randomForest(
  x = XTrain,
  y = yTrain,
  ntree = 500,
  mtry = 4,
  importance = TRUE
)

print(rf_model)

rf_pred <- predict(rf_model, XTest)

rf_rmse <- rmse(yTest, rf_pred)
rf_mae  <- mae(yTest, rf_pred)

rf_plot_data <- rf_test %>%
  select(year_week, crime_count) %>%
  mutate(predicted = rf_pred)

ggplot(rf_plot_data, aes(x = year_week)) +
  geom_line(aes(y = crime_count, linetype = "Actual")) +
  geom_line(aes(y = predicted, linetype = "Predicted")) +
  labs(
    title = "Random Forest versus actual weekly crime counts",
    x = "Week",
    y = "Crime count",
    linetype = ""
  ) +
  theme_minimal()

varImpPlot(rf_model)

```

```{r}
library(sf)
library(dplyr)

# check original CRS first
st_crs(crime_sf)

# force projection to Chicago UTM
crime_sf_proj <- st_transform(crime_sf, 26916)

# confirm
st_crs(crime_sf_proj)
st_bbox(crime_sf_proj)
grid_5km <- st_make_grid(
  st_as_sfc(st_bbox(crime_sf_proj)),
  cellsize = 5000,
  square = TRUE
) %>%
  st_as_sf() %>%
  mutate(grid_id = row_number()) %>%
  arrange(grid_id)

crime_sf_proj <- crime_sf_proj %>%
  mutate(year_week = floor_date(Date, unit = "week", week_start = 1))

# join once
crime_grid_week <- st_join(crime_sf_proj, grid_5km, join = st_within) %>%
  filter(!is.na(grid_id))

# keep only used cells
used_ids <- crime_grid_week %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  distinct(grid_id) %>%
  pull(grid_id)

grid_5km <- grid_5km %>%
  filter(grid_id %in% used_ids) %>%
  arrange(grid_id)

# Rejoin after filtering
crime_grid_week <- st_join(crime_sf_proj, grid_5km, join = st_within) %>%
  filter(!is.na(grid_id))

# Count crimes by grid and week
grid_week_counts <- crime_grid_week %>%
  st_drop_geometry() %>%
  count(grid_id, year_week, name = "crime_count")

# Spatial neighbours and weights
nb <- poly2nb(grid_5km)
lw <- nb2listw(nb, style = "W", zero.policy = TRUE)

# Complete grid-week table
grid_week_full <- grid_week_counts %>%
  complete(
    grid_id = grid_5km$grid_id,
    year_week = seq(min(year_week), max(year_week), by = "week"),
    fill = list(crime_count = 0)
  ) %>%
  arrange(year_week, grid_id)

# Spatial lag
n_cells <- nrow(grid_5km)

calc_spatial_lag <- function(df_week, lw_obj, n_cells) {
  df_week <- df_week %>%
    arrange(grid_id)

  if (nrow(df_week) != n_cells) {
    stop("Row mismatch")
  }

  df_week$spatial_lag <- lag.listw(
    lw_obj,
    df_week$crime_count,
    zero.policy = TRUE
  )

  df_week
}

grid_week_lagged <- grid_week_full %>%
  group_by(year_week) %>%
  group_modify(~ calc_spatial_lag(.x, lw, n_cells)) %>%
  ungroup()

# Temporal lags
grid_week_model <- grid_week_lagged %>%
  arrange(grid_id, year_week) %>%
  group_by(grid_id) %>%
  mutate(
    lag1 = lag(crime_count, 1),
    lag2 = lag(crime_count, 2),
    lag4 = lag(crime_count, 4)
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

# Prepare model data
model_data <- grid_week_model %>%
  filter(
    !is.na(lag1),
    !is.na(lag2),
    !is.na(lag4),
    !is.na(spatial_lag)
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    week_num = isoweek(year_week),
    year_num = year(year_week)
  )

# Train-test split
train_size <- floor(0.8 * nrow(model_data))
train_data <- model_data[1:train_size, ]
test_data  <- model_data[(train_size + 1):nrow(model_data), ]

x_train <- train_data %>%
  select(lag1, lag2, lag4, spatial_lag, week_num, year_num)

y_train <- train_data$crime_count

x_test <- test_data %>%
  select(lag1, lag2, lag4, spatial_lag, week_num, year_num)

y_test <- test_data$crime_count

# Random Forest
set.seed(101)
rf_spacetime <- randomForest(
  x = x_train,
  y = y_train,
  ntree = 300,
  importance = TRUE
)

# Predictions
pred <- predict(rf_spacetime, x_test)
```
